content_of_post_to_comment: WHY do people prefer fakeness?!?! Fake smiles, fake Hi's, fake waves, fake interest?! I dont get it, really I dont. Cos I cant handle it, I really can't, it makes me physically sick. Whyyyy this lying and deceiving?! Can't we just be ourselves, normal, open, honest, true to our nature?! Without faking shit?!?!?!
comment: Maybe the uncomfortable truth is that not all social niceties are deception; sometimes they’re a form of respect. The harder question is where courtesy ends and pretending begins.
